body:
Newsletter from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/newsletter-from-rep-ryan-chamberlin-kqs1grv7ud-12932367?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| | | | |
---
| |
# NEWSLETTER FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN
---
| | Friends and Neighbors,
**Week Five** of the 2026 Legislative Session has come to a close in Tallahassee. I continue working alongside my colleagues to advance legislation that puts Florida first, with a focus on protecting freedoms, supporting families, and strengthening Florida’s future. I look forward to sharing updates as the session continues.
As always, please do not hesitate to [**contact my office**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=1e6514c3d9&e=d1c1b9864f) if there is something we can do for you. My team and I would be more than happy to help you in any way we can.
---
| |
# Bills Presented:
---
|
---
| |
* [**CS/HB 529:**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=d8f627d976&e=d1c1b9864f) Community-based Care Lead Agency and Subcontractor Liability **passed** its second committee stop favorably.
* [**CS/HB 429:**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=25e1af18b8&e=d1c1b9864f) Rep Baker and Chamberlin, Criteria for Determining Criminal Gang Membership, **passed** the House floor last week.

[**If you'd like to follow my bills, please click: Representative Ryan Chamberlin 2026- Sponsored Bills | Florida House of Representatives**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=841583e27d&e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
# Committees:
---
|
---
| | **I have the honor of serving on several important committees for the upcoming 2026 Legislative Session.** Week five is now complete, and these meetings continue to shape the policies and priorities we will carry into the new year.
* [**Ways and Means Committee**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=f41cd7ac36&e=d1c1b9864f)**: **[Ways & Means Committee - 02/10/2026 04:00 PM Meeting Report | Florida House of Representatives](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=d4621d4ada&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [**Justice Budget Subcommittee**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=9099e0e3e1&e=d1c1b9864f)**:**[ Justice Budget Subcommittee - 02/12/2026 08:00 AM Meeting Report | Florida House of Representatives](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=2eab021e9c&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [**Intergovernmental Affairs Subcommittee**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=d8e1cf70cf&e=d1c1b9864f)**:**[ Intergovernmental Affairs Subcommittee - 02/12/2026 09:15 AM Meeting Report | Florida House of Representatives](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=b135550f56&e=d1c1b9864f)
* [**Human Services Subcommittee:**](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=2dd8967427&e=d1c1b9864f) [Human Services Subcommittee - 02/12/2026 02:30 PM Meeting Report | Florida House of Representatives](https://ryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=6d605be8c9&e=d1c1b9864f)
* **Session**

---
| |
# Marion County Day at the Capitol
---
|
---
| |
**It’s always a proud moment to see our local government leaders, dedicated nonprofits, and engaged community members working together and showing up strong for our county.** Marion County continues to set the standard with innovative local leadership, compassionate organizations serving those in need, and a community that truly cares about its future.
I’m grateful for the opportunity to advocate for our shared priorities and to highlight the incredible work being done back home. **Marion County is leading the way, and I’m honored to represent such an outstanding community at the Capitol!**
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| | Enjoyed attending the **2026 Marion County Legislative Reception** hosted by the **Community Foundation for Ocala/Marion County.**
I always look forward to when our local nonprofit partners and community advocates come to Tallahassee.
Thank you to the **Community Foundation** for bringing everyone together and for your continued investment in the success and future of Marion County.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| | Marion County House Delegation and Commissioners
---
|
---
|
---
| | **Enjoyed welcoming students from the College of Central Florida to Tallahassee!** As a proud CF alumni, it’s always an honor to connect with current students, hear about their goals, and talk about the future of our community and state.
Thank you to **Dr. Henningsen** for your leadership and for bringing such an outstanding group of students to the Capitol. CF continues to make a tremendous impact by preparing the next generation for success, and I’m proud to support my alma mater.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | Community Foundation and Nonprofit Leaders from Marion County
---
|
---
|
---
| | Adventhealth Ocala
---
|
---
|
---
| | **A big thank you to Shady Hill Harmony for performing at the Capitol in celebration of Marion County Day!** Your talent and energy brought so much joy to everyone who had the opportunity to listen.
**Congratulations as well on the incredible honor of being selected to sing at Walt Disney World** — what an amazing accomplishment! We are so proud of you and can’t wait to see all that you continue to achieve. Marion County is lucky to have such talented young performers representing our community!
---
| |
# Events/Receptions:
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | **Enjoyed speaking at the inaugural Apostolic Legal Association** event on the topic of church and politics this past Saturday.
Thank you to Stan Lisa Plappert for the invitation.
---
|
---
| |
# Meetings:
---
|
---
| | Enjoyed meeting with the **Florida Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics** and connecting with Dietetics Interns to discuss the vital role nutrition professionals play in supporting the health of Floridians.
From promoting preventative care and healthy lifestyles to helping manage chronic conditions, nutrition experts are essential to improving outcomes and strengthening communities across our state. It was especially encouraging to meet with the next generation of dietetics professionals who are preparing to make a meaningful impact in hospitals, clinics, schools, and communities throughout Florida.
**Thank you all for your advocacy, your passion for improving health outcomes, and for the important work you do every day to help keep Florida healthy.**
---
|
---
| | Dietetics Interns
---
|
---
|
---
| | I appreciated the opportunity to sit down with **The Florida Alliance of Boys & Girls Clubs** to discuss the wonderful work they do for young kids across our state.
From mentorship and academic support to providing safe, positive environments after school and during the summer, these organizations are helping shape the next generation of leaders. **Thank you to The Florida Alliance of Boys & Girls Clubs for your continued dedication to empowering Florida’s youth and strengthening our communities.**
---
|
---
| | Thank you for your continued support of my leadership in the Florida House! I look forward to sharing with you again soon.
Best regards,
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | | | **Ryan Chamberlin****State Representative****District 24**

|

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Another deadline is looming
body:
We need to raise $300,000 before February 21.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter, we’ve got a major pre-primary fundraising deadline coming up on **_February 21_** — and we need to raise **_$300,000_** before then to keep on track.
I’m going to tell you more about what this goal means, but if you’re already with me and ready to show your support, **[please chip in $5 or more right now.](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260213_2_300.g983aC&refcode=em20260213-571&amount=5&t=1&akid=571%2E299639%2EuE-e0V)**
We may not be able to go dollar-for-dollar with Greg Abbott’s $100 million+ campaign war chest.
But here’s the truth: _We don’t need to._
Abbott is burning through his cash on out-of-state, out-of-touch consultants who don’t know Texas and don’t care about Texans.
We’re doing the opposite.
Every single dollar we raise goes to fighting for Texans — showing up everywhere, competing for every vote, and outworking our opponent every single day.
That means late-night drives from Austin to the Panhandle, or from Fort Worth to the Valley. Early-morning events in parks, union halls, and community centers. Clipboards, yard signs, and volunteers knocking doors in every corner of this state.
We’re a scrappy, grassroots campaign — and because of that, every dollar goes farther.
But make no mistake: **This work still costs money.**
Right now, we have a goal to raise **_$300,000_** in three weeks so we can sustain the momentum we’re building on the ground.
Your contribution — no matter the amount — helps put gas in the tank and materials in our volunteers’ hands.
For Greg Abbott, raising this kind of money takes a few phone calls to billionaire donors. For a campaign like ours — one built by hardworking people who believe Texas deserves better — it will take all of us pitching in what we can.
**[I am deeply grateful for any amount you’re able to give. If you can, will you chip in $5 or whatever you’re able today to help us keep going?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260213_2_300.g983aC&refcode=em20260213-571&amount=5&t=2&akid=571%2E299639%2EuE-e0V)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260213_2_300.g983aC&amount=5&refcode=em20260213-571&t=21&akid=571%2E299639%2EuE-e0V)
Thank you for being a part of this fight.
— Gina

clean_body: Sign up to learn about how we’re fighting back for democracy and how you can help. | Peter, There’s A LOT going on when it comes to responding to the national redistricting crisis and the increasing attacks against voting rights in America. So we want to make sure you’re filled in on Redistricting Action’s latest plans to fight back, and how you can help us in this ongoing struggle. It’s easy to feel like there’s too much to keep track of. Some states are currently exploring mid-decade redraws of their congressional maps. The Supreme Court is set to weigh in on the fate of a critical part of the Voting Rights Act. Congress is trying to pass the most anti-voter legislation in recent memory. But voters across the country aren’t giving up, mobilizing everywhere they can to oppose egregious gerrymanders ahead of the midterms. This is a critical time for our democracy. And we can use all the help we can get. | We hope to see you there! The Redistricting Action team Text FAIR to 88228 to receive recurring updates from Redistricting Action by automated text message. I’m proud to share good news with you today:
[**Alamo Scorecard**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=1173ad08d3&e=4d3fe76c62) has officially endorsed our campaign for Congress in TX-21.

Their endorsement is not given lightly.

* Defending the Constitution
* Protecting election integrity
* Standing for faith, family, and freedom
* Fighting for taxpayers and accountability
* Advancing strong, conservative leadership

**Alamo Scorecard reviews records, not rhetoric**. They look at action, not just promises. I’m honored they have recognized our proven record of fighting for conservative principles and standing up to the political establishment.
TX-21 deserves a Congressman who won’t back down, won’t sell out, and won’t forget who he works for — **We the People**.
With your continued [**support**](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=b733be625b&e=4d3fe76c62)[,](https://Trey4TX.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c9a64ea8a402e6526a97d9207&id=d73ba5754a&e=4d3fe76c62) we will win this primary and take our conservative fight to Washington.
Thank you for standing with me.
In liberty,
**Trey Trainor** Husband, Father of 6,Proven Conservative Fighter for TX-21

| **While our "Republican" opponent joined with Democrats in raising taxes, Ron Eller signed the Taxpayer Protection Pledge to NEVER raise taxes**
---
| You may have thought our fellow "conservative Republicans" would know that we are not supposed to raise taxes, but apparently not everyone agrees with us. Our opponent, Kevin Wilson, joined with Democrats in Adams County and voted to increase property taxes up to 30%. He was President of the Board at the time, and [led the vote to a unanimous 5-0 tax increase](https://voteroneller.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cadf08ca3f7559848c17d00e3&id=ccf96963f7&e=a56613e05b).

Mr. Wilson is the only Republican on the Adams County Board of Supervisors. If we can't trust him to stand for Republican values with his neighbors in Adams County, how does anyone think he can stand up to the lobbyists, cronies, and political hacks in Washington DC?

Mr. Wilson even gave a speech about why RAISING taxes was necessary because of a budget shortfall that happened under his watch as President of the Board. He doesn’t want to admit that they didn’t watch the money being spent for an entire year and then found out they were $4 million in the hole. Does that sound like a responsible watchdog over your taxpayer dollars??

Republicans need to take out Bennie Thompson, but replacing him with another reckless tax and spend Republican isn't making a change in DC. [That's why Ron Eller signed the Taxpayer Protection Pledge from the Americans for Tax Reform.](https://voteroneller.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cadf08ca3f7559848c17d00e3&id=ab31b583ed&e=a56613e05b) He pledges to NEVER raise your taxes.

There is a reason that Ron Eller raised TWICE as many dollars from donors as our opponent. They know who the REAL conservative running for Congress in Mississippi's District Two is. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125342743/601476903/1129794561?amount=25&refcode=RS_EM_FR_2026.02.13_BadBunnyonBadBunny&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NzI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDM3NGE2OC0yMzA5LWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDIyNDgyYTk3MzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=G6aa_LCbJX4BTOXEsOdsg712Ky73WrQQkHOsdElEwJY=) Peter! Did you see the Super Bowl halftime show??! **I’m soooo proud of my namesake, Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio, aka Bad Bunny, for an AMAAZING performance. ** Emily and all the humans I was with LOVED it. (Too bad the President didn’t like it 😢) Hooray also for the Seahawks, even though I’m not sure what a Seahawk is! There’s been a lot of darkness and fear in the first few weeks of the year. Let’s not forget what we’re working for: A country where everyone has safety and dignity, no matter what they look like or where they’re from. We can make it happen. As Benito said: _**“I'm here because I never stopped believing in me. And you should believe in yourself, too. You're more valuable than you think, believe me.”**_ At least I think that’s what he said. My Spanish is rusty. Thank you, and take care of yourself 🦴🐶 – Bad Bunny

The file was produced in response to a formal public data request.

* An alleged double-voting incident occurred in Sherburne County on October 4, 2024, during the in-person early [absentee voting](https://substack.com/redirect/bb0dc285-c31f-4586-928b-22e331284707?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) process.
* According to the report, the incident occurred with the "assistance" of a man identified as "_**The Teacher**_."
* The group of 10-12 voters present at the polling place at the time was described by officials as "chaotic."
* A Sherburne County election official reported that he thought it was "weird" that the individual known as "_**The Teacher**_ " repeatedly brought groups of 5-10 people to vote at one time.
* On October 9, 2024, a Sheriff's deputy encountered _**The Teacher**_ , who allegedly presented false identification to law enforcement.
* When questioned, _**The Teacher**_ stated that he was attempting to help individuals overcome barriers to voting, such as language and transportation issues.
* _**The Teacher**_ further confirmed that he had been driving groups of individuals to polling locations to vote.
* Stearns County received an election complaint alleging that interpreters, including _**The Teacher**_ , were directing voters who to vote for at the polling place.
* Stearns County officials reportedly advised _**The Teacher**_ that campaigning inside a polling place is prohibited.
* On October 17, a Sherburne County election official estimated that _**The Teacher**_ had recently transported 100 or more individuals to vote.
* The same official further reported that some voters "did not appear to match the person on their identification."
* A second Sherburne County election official identified _**The Teacher**_ as the individual who had been bringing in groups on a daily basis.

In the fall of 2024, I initiated election challenges to stop counties from posting their official ballot (including the customized "timing marks") for download on their website. Two of the counties were in the St. Cloud Area - Stearns and Benton County. Read [here ](https://substack.com/redirect/a2b69393-14a7-4b12-87c0-c4862b3df377?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)for more background on this effort and the difference between a "draft" or "sample" ballot and the official ballot.
As a result of this effort, I connected with multiple local concerned citizens. One issue that was reported to me involved a series of suspicious voting incidents occurring at the pre-election day polling sites in all three area counties - Stearns, Benton, and Sherburne. I made a series of inquiries but could not obtain any official confirmation that there were any such investigations.
The significance of any potential voter influence operation became more pronounced following the vote reporting irregularities that surfaced during the 2024 election in Minnesota House District 14B.At the time, I told [Alpha News](https://substack.com/redirect/b14a9507-0723-43aa-a07a-d27b76552aa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> "We started with Sue Ek ahead by four votes, then down by 28 votes, and then magically down by 191 votes, which was outside the mandatory recount," said Benda.
Coincidentally, Sherburne County later [reported ](https://substack.com/redirect/701f0446-6230-45b9-aaf1-0ac873623290?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)that additional _absentee ballots_ were uploaded after the initial election results were released -- ultimately shifting the outcome to Ek's opponent. Throughout the recount process, no Sherburne County official disclosed the existence of a detailed investigative report dated October 21, 2024, which documented evidence of potential impropriety. Further, criminal charges were not filed until December 11, 2024 -- _shortly after_ the November 25 recount concluded.
In late 2025, a concerned citizen informed me that a criminal case had been filed in Sherburne County relating to the pre-election incident described above. On January 2, 2026, I submitted a formal data request and am now reviewing the redacted records produced in response.
_**The Teacher**_ was charged with two misdemeanor offenses: providing false identification to a peace officer and driving without a valid driver's license. Pursuant to a plea agreement, the false identification charge was dismissed and he pleaded guilty to driving without a license. The court imposed a 90-day suspended sentence -- meaning no jail time if he remains law-abiding -- along with $185 in fines and fees.
Stay tuned for more information as this investigation continues.

U.S. Sen. Susan Collins (R-Maine) is throwing her weight behind the House-passed SAVE America Act, saying the revised bill strikes the right balance between election security and voter access -- while making clear she won't support scrapping the Senate's legislative filibuster to get it across the finish line.
In an exclusive comment to _The Maine Wire_ , Sen. Collins said she supports the current version of the SAVE Act, which would require proof of citizenship to vote in U.S. elections.

Collins said she will support the version of the SAVE Act that has now cleared the House, calling it a "simple reform" aimed at strengthening confidence in federal elections.
"The law is clear that in this country only American citizens are eligible to vote in federal elections. In addition, having people provide an ID at the polls, just as they have to do before boarding an airplane, checking into a hotel, or buying an alcoholic beverage, is a simple reform that will improve the security of our federal elections and will help give people more confidence in the results," she said.
Subscribe to the Robinson Report for exclusive breaking news.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..BNUmwfI8xIuBb3U5_Kt_CjQhxFs-R-MeGvkaKO1xijQ?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=187903185)
Collins said that her support hinges on changes made to the legislation. She said she previously opposed an earlier draft that would have required voters to prove their citizenship each time they cast a ballot.
"Requiring voters to produce passports or birth certificates on election day -- as opposed to just a state-issued ID -- would have placed an unnecessary burden on the voters. That provision is no longer in the bill and dropping this requirement was key to getting my support."
Although conservatives will cheer the news that Collins will support citizenship requirements for voting via the SAVE Act, her support comes with a key caveat: preserving the Senate filibuster.

The Maine senator drew a firm red line when it comes to changing Senate rules to pass the bill.
"I oppose eliminating the legislative filibuster," Collins said. "The filibuster is an important protection for the rights of the minority party, that requires Senators to work together in the best interest of the country. Removing that protection would, for example, allow a future Congress controlled by Democrats to pass provisions on anything they want -- DC Statehood, open borders, or packing the Supreme Court -- with just a simple majority of Senators."
The legislative filibuster requires 60 votes to advance most major bills in the Senate. Democrats have periodically called for weakening or eliminating it, arguing it allows a minority to block widely supported legislation.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..o0dRsaQtyDptJcWEdCJOZzCrK4ouPqCuHL2tKIU3AYg?)
Some Republicans, including Collins, have defended the 60-vote threshold as a guardrail against rapid policy swings when power changes hands.

Other Republicans and most conservative commentators have predicted that a future Democratic majority in the Senate would abolish the long-standing Senate filibuster in order to stack the U.S. Supreme Court and further assert progressive dominance over American life.

In addition, having people provide an ID at the polls, just as they have to do before boarding an airplane, checking into a hotel, or buying an alcoholic beverage, is a simple reform that will improve the security of our federal elections and will help give people more confidence in the results. I opposed a previous version of this bill that would have required people to prove their citizenship every single time they cast a ballot. Requiring voters to produce passports or birth certificates on election day -- as opposed to just a state-issued ID -- would have placed an unnecessary burden on the voters. That provision is no longer in the bill and dropping this requirement was key to getting my support.
> I oppose eliminating the legislative filibuster. The filibuster is an important protection for the rights of the minority party, that requires Senators to work together in the best interest of the country. Removing that protection would, for example, allow a future Congress controlled by Democrats to pass provisions on anything they want -- DC Statehood, open borders, or packing the Supreme Court -- with just a simple majority of Senators.

| | Here’s the reality: my office identified troubling connections involving accreditation pipelines, shared facilities, and ownership or governance structures that raised serious legal, financial, and national security concerns.
**That’s unacceptable.**
Schools with ties to terrorist organizations or foreign adversaries will not be permitted to participate. Education freedom is about empowering parents to choose the best educational path for their children. **Texans should never be forced to subsidize institutions that threaten our security or undermine our values. Now, that same fight has reached our classrooms.**
This is the same principle that led Texas to divest state pension funds from hostile regimes, secure the border through Operation Lone Star after Joe Biden refused to, empower sheriffs to enforce immigration law with ICE, and ban land purchases by foreign adversaries.
[**I will always stand for Texas and protect our families and taxpayer dollars. Are you with me?**](https://kellyhancock.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dcaa9ba5f084f891ef21f7388&id=8c16a2c2d5&e=c7a460ad3d)

Friend, Families are struggling to afford healthcare, utilities, groceries, and housing. Meanwhile, billionaire oligarchs keep buying political influence, rigging the system in their favor, and getting richer. Over the past year, Trump’s net worth has grown by over $4 billion. As president, he takes every chance he gets to enrich himself and his friends, often illegally. While enacting massive tax cuts for the rich and sending unprecedented billions to private contractors that run ICE detention centers, Trump has slashed life-saving funds for the poor and working class. I’m fighting back in Congress, including by**introducing a new**** _Defund the Oligarchs, Fund Our Communities_****resolution** with other progressive colleagues. This legislation calls for ending the system of corporate tax breaks and federal contracts for billionaire-backed companies that bankroll political campaigns. It demands Congress tax the rich and big corporations while reinvesting in our communities’ needs—such as healthcare, housing, education, and other essentials. [**Please sign on today to call on Congress to support my new resolution to _Defund the Oligarchs and Fund Our Communities_.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-inXg7XQKmpx2SINKyl6WQz_vkJ3ZJKcUzkkSwqwfKGeA77vOoOShpp-YonFcsjiP5yD_objAFsWX6e_LysP13wqEM5N9UhIN2VXsYdV22dGhiak8puIcrXNm7NH11i-hs3JmzUUoPzlishqkaXpM2P4D4egW5oEmhRkFyqkomT5JPbnLgeDLJ-OuOJvRJ-M5pzY1GZmCcuJ5n-826Q8DTsLM_3SBt0_nkJiR0IvRdTQ8gZ-5TZ5yamQRmZHlFFubh0QCSk4r_lw4b4Y5vXd8WtbcwLaafe15FtAC-ZmyreZWgJfh6b0uOcxgghRF8x9nmoBacS4gDwHkmL2lUd4HmOkNS0pAEM3txxtWXwWJ7gFE7KZ-QeRAMxD02gbcwMjAY7RZ18TzeJKK2AAmjEQGq/4o4/ttyppi7XSxeHx9_4aBnelw/h1/h001.VVVa8kb-k1eSz6IBZg4W-vY7ak34vCcfteNPrZICFyM) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-inXg7XQKmpx2SINKyl6WQz_vkJ3ZJKcUzkkSwqwfKGeA77vOoOShpp-YonFcsjiP5yD_objAFsWX6e_LysP13wqEM5N9UhIN2VXsYdV22dGhiak8puIcrXNm7NH11i-hs3JmzUUoPzlishqkaXpM2P4D4egW5oEmhRkFyqkomT5JPbnLgeDLJ-OuOJvRJ-M4QeF6adbt2LMBU5PbcF4sYWtApG6qE3hqM6KH-YgexqVju7k03PFx47ds1kSwjvCCVMUvE-9V05STHUFFqVDNtETE_Pr-Xs_u3Jwl90MCyzvG2bF8kDGqBSoMDrbBPnvlZfNzJS5l07NytSD-CF2YzfO9lkgAg_H8B5v9vCQkDFCjQOqsKOT6k8KEk50pZPo667qPmD-6UR9_sQc4vlkGH/4o4/ttyppi7XSxeHx9_4aBnelw/h2/h001.Hw1E0KDR8b5Qja64VMocY0KjhZLgZFAY4oGey1l2hr8)

In the last election, Trump’s biggest donors included the fossil fuel, crypto, and private prison/detention industries. They made huge returns on their investments: For every million they spent, they gained around $18 billion on average.
Trump is helping concentrate their wealth even further through tax breaks, corrupt agreements, government contracts, and industry-friendly policies that harm our communities. **Almost all of this is paid for by American taxpayers.**
This money belongs to us. These are public resources, which should be redirected to fund people’s needs.
Instead of being responsive to the needs of the people, many lawmakers on both sides of the aisle do the bidding of their billionaire and corporate donors.
**We can’t meet people’s needs if billionaires and corporations are writing the rules. To ensure a real democracy where our leaders actually represent us and our needs, we must change this system.** **That’s part of how we fight fascism and how we fight for economic, racial, social, and environmental justice.**
**Congress must make the ultra-rich pay their fair share** , break up corporate monopolies, and end the campaign finance system that enables billionaire and corporate control over our government.
**Congress must also reinvest our taxpayer dollars into our communities** , and help build an economy that supports democracy instead of undermining it.

[**If you agree that public money should serve the people rather than billionaires, please sign the petition to support the**** _Defund the Oligarchs, Fund Our Communitie_****s resolution.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3-inXg7XQKmpx2SINKyl6WQz_vkJ3ZJKcUzkkSwqwfKGeA77vOoOShpp-YonFcsjiP5yD_objAFsWX6e_LysP13wqEM5N9UhIN2VXsYdV22dGhiak8puIcrXNm7NH11i-hs3JmzUUoPzlishqkaXpM2P4D4egW5oEmhRkFyqkomT5JPbnLgeDLJ-OuOJvRJ-M7YNCe8BH1kh46tpBEzOMokSMn-uWHSkbwALxBZv94hOKmfeUJvNOxAc2rpUJ1JjGr-MyYry3UF9vsbHJ4yQpXQCB1p86-fwEurx4vcccIlPbFKjwyU_jLVGMiHMjHc02Fd7tJIq6YNmQ6SwYasY52ajUFb4XBEqpAs_HS9Kut6FzA2XwNuBg0-Spf_gAVcw2sf6D1l05o1z0arl7qkqCWj/4o4/ttyppi7XSxeHx9_4aBnelw/h3/h001.0at95XmvMrUoMOhHKT5TjP0r1BDGJDYecFzPYeTDdgY)
Thank you. We won’t be fooled by billionaires’ attempts to dehumanize and divide us. We see how they’re stealing from us, and instead of falsely blaming our neighbors, we’re joining together and demanding major changes.
We must remember that we have power. It’s always outside movements that move institutions like Congress and the Oval Office to make change.
Although we’re up against big money, we have the power of numbers. The United States has 900 billionaires; there are MANY more of us than them. Together, we can take back our government and our democracy _for the people_.
With you in the fight for better,
Rashida

Peter, it’s Valerie Foushee. We’re 18 days out from Election Day, and early voting started yesterday, so I wanted to take a minute to talk about what’s happening in this race. From the very beginning, this campaign has been about serving my community. My focus has always been on delivering real results for this district, working across differences, solving problems, and making sure your voice is heard. **Every campaign I’ve run was about seeing a need, and wanting to give back to a community that had given to me.** You won’t often see me standing on the Capitol steps chasing cameras or cable news clips. Today marks one full year since RFK Jr. was confirmed as Secretary of Health and Human Services.

| | The Georgia General Assembly is back in session — so we’re on high alert. For the first few months of the year, our lawmakers have a chance to write, debate, and pass laws that tackle critical issues, from access to health care and the cost of living to public education. But all too often, anti-voter extremists use this time period to advance legislation that restricts our freedoms, including the freedom to vote. In recent years, new Georgia laws have criminalized handing out food and water to voters in line, imposed burdensome voter ID requirements, made mass voter purges easier, and placed unnecessary limits on ballot drop boxes. And what happens in Georgia doesn’t stay in Georgia — our state has become a laboratory for new voter suppression measures that spread across the country. clean_body: What happens in Georgia doesn’t stay in Georgia | | | The Georgia General Assembly is back in session — so we’re on high alert. For the first few months of the year, our lawmakers have a chance to write, debate, and pass laws that tackle critical issues, from access to health care and the cost of living to public education. But all too often, anti-voter extremists use this time period to advance legislation that restricts our freedoms, including the freedom to vote. In recent years, new Georgia laws have criminalized handing out food and water to voters in line, imposed burdensome voter ID requirements, made mass voter purges easier, and placed unnecessary limits on ballot drop boxes. And what happens in Georgia doesn’t stay in Georgia — our state has become a laboratory for new voter suppression measures that spread across the country. = If you've saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically: | = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- = | = ---|--- Last year, activists like you helped fend off new attempts at voter suppression in the 2025 legislative session — including cuts to early voting, a ban on dropping off mail ballots over the weekend before Election Day, and expanded partisan poll watcher access to sensitive areas in elections offices. Those pieces of legislation fit into a broader pattern of limiting who gets a say in our democracy. And we fought back alongside a pro-voting rights coalition. Through legislative tracking, lobbying legislators, public advocacy and education that included a Grassroots Lobby Day at the Capitol, rallying constituents to contact key lawmakers, and more, we helped protect free and fair elections. None of those bills ended up passing. But as anti-democracy extremists continue to escalate their efforts, we have to be ready to push back even harder — so that every voter has the freedom to make their voice heard. = In solidarity, The Fair Fight Action Team * = = | 1270 Caroline Street | Suite D120-430 | Atlanta, GA 30307 ©2026 Fair Fight Action - All rights reserved. Friend,

Yesterday, the House passed the revised SAVE Act by a narrow 218–213 vote. I was proud to support this common-sense measure to restore integrity and confidence in our elections. The SAVE Act ensures that **only** American citizens are voting in American elections. The legislation would require voters to:· Provide proof of citizenship when registering to vote, such as a passport or birth certificate along with a photo ID· Present a valid photo ID when voting, including a driver’s license, state ID, or tribal identification· Submit a copy of a photo ID when requesting and returning an absentee ballot It also requires states to regularly submit voter rolls to the Department of Homeland Security so citizenship status can be verified and imposes additional identification safeguards in states that fail to comply. This is not complicated. One citizen who is ineligible to vote is one too many because it cancels out the vote of a legal United States citizen. We’ve seen the Democratic playbook. The left wants to expand voting to non-citizens. I fundamentally disagree, and I will continue fighting to ensure our elections are secure and fair. But I need your help. The fight to protect election integrity is far from over, and outside groups are already mobilizing against members who supported this bill. If you stand with me, will you contribute today?[Chip in $25](https://scottfitzgeraldforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c59bc0db5e945d61b14749b2b&id=c1e1db0e7b&e=561a28864e)[Chip in $50](https://scottfitzgeraldforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c59bc0db5e945d61b14749b2b&id=4879f69b67&e=561a28864e)[Chip in $100](https://scottfitzgeraldforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c59bc0db5e945d61b14749b2b&id=62bc08d712&e=561a28864e)[Chip in $250](https://scottfitzgeraldforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c59bc0db5e945d61b14749b2b&id=6b4243c87e&e=561a28864e)[Or give $500 to help us stay on offense.](https://scottfitzgeraldforcongress.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c59bc0db5e945d61b14749b2b&id=299f8d87f9&e=561a28864e) Your support ensures we can continue defending the integrity of our elections and pushing back against efforts that weaken our democratic process. Thank you for standing with me.
**** Sincerely,

The current wannabe dictator was put in the Oval Office by a coordinated effort of billionaires and right-wing elites who used their money and power to take over every aspect of our political system. **Key to that takeover was the packing of the Supreme Court with MAGA loyalists and the warping of our justice system.** That’s why United for Democracy coordinates with allied groups fighting for immigrants, trans folks, abortion rights, the environment, and beyond. **Every issue we care about is directly affected by the corrupt MAGA Supreme Court.** **It’s also why we’re proud to be sponsoring the next No Kings nationwide rally on Saturday, March 28th. | Peter,

I want to explain a vote I took earlier this month.

I voted no on funding the Department of Homeland Security, even for a short-term extension.

Let me be clear. I support funding the federal government.

Two weeks earlier, I voted for five appropriations bills to keep federal agencies operating through the rest of the year. As the representative of more than 35,000 federal employees and active duty service members, I take that responsibility seriously.

But I will not support a blank check for an agency that is operating without accountability. We need guardrails like prohibiting ICE agents from wearing masks, requiring body cameras, banning the detention or deportation of U.S. citizens, ending arrests without judicial warrants, and enforcing real transparency and accountability.

I’ll keep up the fight in Congress to fund government responsibly while holding powerful agencies accountable, but I need your help powering my reelection campaign.

I voted no on funding the Department of Homeland Security, even for a short-term extension. | = | Peter, I want to explain a vote I took earlier this month. I voted no on funding the Department of Homeland Security, even for a short-term extension. Let me be clear. I support funding the federal government. Two weeks earlier, I voted for five appropriations bills to keep federal agencies operating through the rest of the year. As the representative of more than 35,000 federal employees and active duty service members, I take that responsibility seriously. But I will not support a blank check for an agency that is operating without accountability. We need guardrails like prohibiting ICE agents from wearing masks, requiring body cameras, banning the detention or deportation of U.S. citizens, ending arrests without judicial warrants, and enforcing real transparency and accountability. I’ll keep up the fight in Congress to fund government responsibly while holding powerful agencies accountable, but I need your help powering my reelection campaign. = | | | = | = | = | = | = Thank you for being part of this fight. Hi Peter, Democracy isn't a spectator sport, and it sure as hell isn't built from the top down. While the pundits obsess over the latest authoritarian power grab, we’re busy rebuilding the foundation from the dirt up. At Local Democracy Project, we believe in a different kind of patriotism. Not the performative kind _\- the real kind._ The kind that says “we all do better when we all do better.” It’s a love story for our neighbors, and we’re writing the next chapter by:
* **Recruiting:** Finding the local badasses ready to lead.
* **Training:** Giving them the tactical gear to win smart.
* **Supporting:** Protecting them as they take back school boards, city halls, and county commissions.

The assault on our country is real, but so is our grit. Friend, it's Heidi Hall.
I'm so proud to announce that our campaign for Congress has earned the support of the Jane Fonda Climate PAC.
As a former Environmental Protection Agency worker and lifelong environmentalist, having them on our side in this race means so much to me.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20260213_em_fr_b1_HH_BIG [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20260213_em_fr_b1_HH_BIG]
I worked for over 20 years in the EPA to hold corporate polluters accountable and fought to protect communities from hazardous waste and toxic chemical dumping.
And for 10 more years , I worked with the State Department of Water Resources to protect ecosystems around rivers and waterways.
Friend, I don't take this endorsement lightly.
The fossil fuel industry and their lobbyists have a stranglehold on our members of Congress, buying their votes and holding hundreds of thousands of dollars over their heads.
The only way that we're going to be able to beat them back and counter their spending is by working together.
Friend, I'm ready to fight like hell to protect our environment. Will you join the Jane Fonda Climate PAC in supporting my run for Congress by donating any amount that you can today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20260213_em_fr_b1_HH_BIG]

Heidi Hall
Heidi Hall has spent her three-decade public service career working with others to solve problems, protect our land and water, improve health, and build opportunities for others, all while raising two boys primarily as a single mom.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20260213_em_fr_b1_HH_BIG [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hall-email?refcode=20260213_em_fr_b1_HH_BIG]
Raised by parents who had persisted to make a middle-class life for their kids in Contra Costa County while lifting up others, Heidi was taught to push through and overcome challenges rather than complain about them. She learned to stick up for the vulnerable, to respect working people, and to value equal opportunity and justice.
After graduating from Pomona College and earning graduate degrees from Columbia and Rutgers, Heidi went to work for the Rockefeller Foundation promoting reproductive care and then began her career at the Environmental Protection Agency, stopping the dumping of toxic waste and holding corporate polluters accountable.
Today, Heidi chairs the Nevada County Board of Supervisors, where she’s taken on homelessness, expanded broadband access, and worked to reduce crime and illegal cannabis growth. Heidi flipped her seat from red to blue – and now she’s ready to do it again in Congress to take on toxic politics in Washington and put people first.

She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

subject: Have your expenses gone up, Peter? 📈
body:
We’re curious how your wallet’s feeling.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=551%2E124072%2EVMREzn)
We have one quick question for Roy's supporters, Peter — **[Do you feel like your expenses — housing, groceries, utilities — have gotten MORE expensive?](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/em_RC_PET_AffordabilityPoll/?source=em_RC_PET_AffordabilityPoll_021326&t=7&akid=551%2E124072%2EVMREzn)** | [YES](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/em_RC_PET_AffordabilityPoll/?source=em_RC_PET_AffordabilityPoll_021326&t=8&akid=551%2E124072%2EVMREzn) | [NO](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/em_RC_PET_AffordabilityPoll/?source=em_RC_PET_AffordabilityPoll_021326&t=9&akid=551%2E124072%2EVMREzn)
---|---
If you answered yes, you're not alone — **nearly HALF of Americans say groceries, utility bills, health care, housing and transportation are difficult to afford these days.**
What happened? Republicans were supposedly elected to make things _more_ affordable, not less.
Instead, chaotic policies have caused prices on everything from clothes to smartphones to keep rising. They allowed health care subsidies to expire, forcing families to make impossible choices with their wallets. About a _quarter_ of Americans have skipped a medical check-up or a prescription dose because of costs within the last two years.
_We’re getting the bad end of the bargain._
**That's why Roy is running for the U.S. Senate: to bring down costs, create good-paying jobs, and make life affordable for working families.** But with the clock ticking down to November, he wants to hear directly from YOU about this, Peter.
**[So we're asking again: Does your life feel MORE expensive these days? Let us know where you stand.](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/em_RC_PET_AffordabilityPoll/?source=em_RC_PET_AffordabilityPoll_021326&t=10&akid=551%2E124072%2EVMREzn)**

---|---
Thanks for weighing in,
Team Cooper
* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

The Trump Administration on Friday released a [massive data file ](https://substack.com/redirect/43133fe8-932e-46f4-a606-c28b3f2db79c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)that will serve as a treasure map for anyone interested in finding Medicaid fraud and taking the U.S. Treasury Department up on its [reward offer](https://substack.com/redirect/05949ce1-1076-4694-bfc4-32478b4eece2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for those who help expose fraudsters.
The file -- which is a little unwieldy for the average computer user to work with -- will take some time to process.
But the first glimpse at spending by category provides a stunning perspective on the true nature of Medicaid, known in Maine as MaineCare.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..iA73Q_iEjc4WjveFm2lxGIvuJUq0taibK6saWR37pE4?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=187907588)
Rather than a health care program or a health insurance program, Medicaid spending is dominated by soft-services that fall under the umbrella of "Personal Care Services."
Under federal law, this is defined as follows: "Assistance with activities of daily living (ADLs) and instrumental activities of daily living (IADLs) provided to a person who cannot perform these tasks independently."
This includes services for those with Autism Spectrum Disorder or Intellectual and Developmental Disorders -- the two programs that have, according to federal investigations, been subject to the highest rate of improper payments, a.k.a. fraud.
In Maine, those "Personal Care Services" operate under MaineCare Section 21 or 29 for developmental disabilities. However, the home health care agencies that have proliferate across Maine can also bill taxpayers for PCS.
[[RELATED: Five Star Fraud: Records Show Home Health Agency Over-billed MaineCare by Nearly $400k, Disappeared...]](https://substack.com/redirect/be4f53b5-340e-4cb4-ab68-8fe85eb528ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
That would include the 10+ home health care agencies we found at a single office building in Portland, along with the half dozen home health care agencies we found a separate Portland location co-located with a Somali money transfer company.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..Fz7mj8RkACljr0untpw6i_hhaE4HEmTGYd_sJI6kVHE?)
[[RELATED: Portland Office Becomes a Hub for Medicaid "Home Health" and Somali Money Transfers...]](https://substack.com/redirect/389f3088-a53d-4e52-b33c-5a00b66901cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The Maine Wire identified these locations because we obtained Maine's portion of the now-public data last year under a Freedom of Access Act request. By examining the provider payment data, in conjunction with address and director data, we were able to easily identify anomalous patterns in spending.
Many of the most intelligent and handsome conservatives have been calling for this transparency play since President Donald Trump took office for his second term. It's difficult to overstate the mass awakening that will unfold as a result of this disclosure.
[| | | | | Steve Robinson

body:
Let’s build a Wisconsin where we share the table — where everyone has a seat, a say, and a fair shot at a better life.
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260213-2510)
Peter,
Thank you for joining our movement. It's people like you who power everything we do, and I’m so glad we're in this fight together.
This campaign is about all of us — workers, parents, organizers, neighbors — coming together to fight for what we deserve.
I started my career as a line cook in a kitchen... right across the street from the State Capitol. I worked my way up to executive chef and even opened my own restaurant. Like so many service workers, I know what it means to hustle just to survive.
Five years ago, when COVID hit the service industry, my community and I came together to support those affected and respond to the crisis. They then sent me to the Capitol. As a single mom, a service worker, and a community organizer, I’ve seen up close the rigged system that puts billionaires and corporations over families, workers, and our communities.
**Now, I’m running for Governor to fix this broken system. For too long, we’ve been told doing better isn’t possible. Let me tell you: that’s bullshit.**
We _can_ do better. We make better possible. And if you’re ready to roll up your sleeves, we’d love to have you on the ground with us.
**Here are a few ways you can plug in:**
* Follow us on [**Twitter**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/293?t=1&akid=2510%2E105371%2ETVvifq), [**Instagram**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/294?t=2&akid=2510%2E105371%2ETVvifq), [**Facebook**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/295?t=3&akid=2510%2E105371%2ETVvifq), [**TikTok**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/296?t=4&akid=2510%2E105371%2ETVvifq), [**Threads**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/297?t=5&akid=2510%2E105371%2ETVvifq), and [**Bluesky**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/298?t=6&akid=2510%2E105371%2ETVvifq) to get the latest updates;
* Chip in whatever you can to help **[fuel this grassroots-powered campaign](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_welcome_ak.TRCEmP&refcode=em20260213-2510&t=7&akid=2510%2E105371%2ETVvifq)** ;
* Sign up to volunteer using [**this form**](https://act.francescahong.com/go/299?t=8&akid=2510%2E105371%2ETVvifq).

Let’s build a Wisconsin where we share the table — where everyone has a seat, a say, and a fair shot at a better life.
With gratitude,
Fran

Dr. Michael Baden, who attended Jeffrey Epstein's 2019 autopsy at the request of Epstein's brother, **[is demanding a fresh investigation into the convicted pedophile's death,](https://substack.com/redirect/9299648a-0cb2-4484-9c00-096a03b42d9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** saying newly released DOJ documents reinforce his belief that the medical examiner rushed to call the death a suicide. "The autopsy findings are much more consistent with a crushing injury caused by homicidal strangulation than caused by hanging by suicide," Baden told the Telegraph.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9299648a-0cb2-4484-9c00-096a03b42d9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** Baden pointed to three fractures in Epstein's neck as key evidence, saying "even one fracture, we have to investigate the possibility of a homicide. Two definitely warrant a full investigation," adding that in decades of experience he has never witnessed such fractures in a hanging suicide. He also argued the neck markings were inconsistent with a bedsheet noose, saying the injuries "would have required a different type of material."
* **The big picture:** Newly released documents show the cause of death was initially marked as "pending," supporting Baden's belief that more investigation was needed -- but just five days after the autopsy, Chief Medical Examiner Barbara Sampson declared Epstein's death a suicide by hanging, blindsiding Baden without any additional findings. A 2024 panel of six senior forensic pathologists re-examined the case with mixed results -- four ruled it a suicide while two found it impossible to give a definitive ruling. The Trump administration has accepted the suicide ruling.

Prominent Palestinian activist Nerdeen Kiswani sparked outrage in New York City by declaring dogs unclean and **[unsuitable as indoor pets under Islamic teachings,](https://substack.com/redirect/7089d8b8-c4de-43c6-b400-2314dca043ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** urging the city to embrace such restrictions amid widespread complaints about dog waste in snow-covered streets--though she later insisted the post was satirical.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7089d8b8-c4de-43c6-b400-2314dca043ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Provocative X Post:** Kiswani wrote that dogs belong in society but not indoors, calling them unclean per Islamic views and tying it to NYC's "coming to Islam."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4d58b608-a897-4bc6-a894-88fea70a149c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Backlash Erupts:** The comment drew fierce criticism onl
ine, with many viewing it as an attempt to impose religious beliefs on urban pet owners in diverse New York.
* **Satire Defense Offered:** After backlash, Kiswani claimed the remark was a joke mocking "Zionists" and highlighting real issues like unscooped dog poop in unmelted snow.
* **Activist Background Context:** Known for leading pro-Palestine protests via Within Our Lifetime, Kiswani has faced prior accusations of extremism and anti-Semitism in her activism.

# CCP official fathers 26 babies with goal to crown one U.S. President
A senior Chinese Communist Party official and his partner allegedly **[exploited California's surrogacy industry to produce at least 26 children](https://substack.com/redirect/fbac7156-c190-4331-bd5a-45c4f47be854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** via surrogates, with the man reportedly obsessed that one offspring--granted U.S. birthright citizenship--would someday become president, according to a new investigative report.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fbac7156-c190-4331-bd5a-45c4f47be854?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

* **Home-Based Agency Scheme** : The couple operated Mark Surrogacy from their multimillion-dollar Arcadia mansion, posing as an unmarried pair to recruit unaware surrogates for Xuan's sperm and anonymous donors.
* **Children Named Boldly** : Several kids were named after U.S. presidents and foreign leaders, **[reportedly due to Xuan's jealousy](https://substack.com/redirect/b4a40328-2369-4f97-ab11-f3f24fe58e7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** over his ineligibility as a non-natural-born citizen to run for office.
* **Broader Influence Fears** : The case highlights concerns over Chinese elites using surrogacy for birthright citizenship, amid reports of 107 similar Chinese-owned agencies in California exploiting U.S. immigration laws.

# Obama allies melt down over Trump climate repeal
Former President **[Barack Obama and allies including Al Gore erupted in fury](https://substack.com/redirect/8a4f90d2-2cd4-44da-a43f-27063ba326f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Thursday after the Trump administration, led by EPA chief Lee Zeldin, repealed the landmark 2009 Endangerment Finding, stripping federal authority to regulate greenhouse gases as a public health threat and hailing it as the largest deregulatory move in U.S. history.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8a4f90d2-2cd4-44da-a43f-27063ba326f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Fierce Democratic Backlash** : Obama warned the repeal leaves Americans less safe and healthy while boosting fossil fuel profits, as California vows court challenges against the move.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1007c927-d2d9-4ba4-bf59-3668abcf093c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Trump 's Bold Claim** : President Trump called the action the single largest deregulatory step ever, projecting over $1 trillion in savings for taxpayers and greater vehicle affordability.
* **EPA Legal Shift** : Administrator Zeldin ruled the Obama-era finding exceeded congressional authority under the Clean Air Act, eliminating the basis for vehicle emissions standards and related rules.
* **Al Gore 's Sharp Rebuke** : The former vice president accused the administration of denying science by discarding research linking climate change to public health risks.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: “Has your party betrayed its base?”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Alexandria was just onstage at the Munich Security Conference.
#
_Today, on a panel at the Munich Security Conference, Alexandria was asked, “Has your party betrayed its base?” Here was her answer:_
I was first elected in 2018, and I was a waitress in New York City.
I had no health insurance, I could not pay my rent, and I consistently saw a party that championed special interests, the elite — a Democratic Party that was very much telling working people that “everything was fine” when it, in fact, wasn’t.
After I was elected, I remember there was a closed-door meeting of many high ranking Democratic Party officials. At that time — a long time ago — they derided many of the populist demands that I had run my campaign on.
I had defeated a 20-year Democratic incumbent that was part of Democratic Party leadership. And they said, “$15 minimum wage? Way too high, too severe.”
The idea of tuition-free public colleges and universities? Too far.
Expanding healthcare and Medicare? Too extreme.
These were all things that I as a waitress had campaigned on, and had been major pain points in my life.
**And then they said, “We have to listen to working class people more.”**
I think that encapsulates much of the betrayal that the working class in the United States have felt.
But we have come a long way since then — and we have a long way to go.
The United States right now is experiencing a political pendulum. And really the party that is seen most as betraying the working-class is the governing party. Right now, that happens to be the Republican majority.
What we are seeing over the last eight years has been a growing recognition of those past errors, that include military interventionism in the Iraq War, a recognition of NAFTA as a failed policy for many rural and working class communities.
Now I think we are moving in this direction of increased recognition that **we have to have a working class centered politics if we are going to succeed** , and also if we are going to stave off the scourges of authoritarianism, which also provides political siren calls to allure people into finding scapegoats to blame for rising economic inequality, both domestically and globally.
That’s what this movement is fighting for: to center working-class people in the halls of Congress and in every corner of this country.

**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260213.JecQdM&refcode=em20260213-10781-P_FND_CTR_CTR&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=10781%2E2526796%2EBKmLE4)**
We will keep you informed as Alexandria continues to participate in the Munich Security Conference.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

Galentine’s Day is about celebrating the women who show up for each other — the friends, mentors, and communities that help us grow, lead, and thrive.
That same spirit drives Emerge.

_Democrats Running In Every State Senate District For First Time Since 1974_ [__](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125347816/601492323/302982835?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjI5NGIzMC0zMjA5LWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDIyNDgyYTk3MzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cbisk2qV_2XWXz4uyMeImI0JyXJEOZhg7WUSUFFb9UI=&emci=e400d1d1-2f09-f111-832e-0022482a9733&emdi=1f294b30-3209-f111-832e-0022482a9733&ceid=4925535) Hoosier Democrats are entering this election cycle with all the momentum. For the first time since the aftermath of the Watergate scandal in 1974, we have Democratic candidates running for every Indiana State Senate seat up for election this November. We also have State House candidates running in 91 of 100 districts, the most since Indiana instituted single-member districts in 1992. Hoosiers are fed up with 21+ years of unchecked Republican rule and ready to elect Democrats all across the state. **[If you’d like to help us make the most of the moment, consider chipping into our 2026 Ready Fund today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125347817/601492324/383765187?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjI5NGIzMC0zMjA5LWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDIyNDgyYTk3MzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cbisk2qV_2XWXz4uyMeImI0JyXJEOZhg7WUSUFFb9UI=)** ****_Harmful Language Allowing Large Projects Without Public Input Removed From Bill After Public Backlash_
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125347818/601492325/-705409415?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjI5NGIzMC0zMjA5LWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDIyNDgyYTk3MzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cbisk2qV_2XWXz4uyMeImI0JyXJEOZhg7WUSUFFb9UI=&emci=e400d1d1-2f09-f111-832e-0022482a9733&emdi=1f294b30-3209-f111-832e-0022482a9733&ceid=4925535) The Braun Republican supermajority in the Indiana State House last week passed HB 1333, which would have stripped oversight authority on large commercial developments away from local government, making it easier for major projects like industrial facilities and data centers to move forward without input from the community. Farm families, local leaders, and Hoosiers across the political spectrum stood up and made their voices heard, and this language was removed from the bill. When Hoosiers stand together, we can accomplish anything. Now it’s time to replace the Republicans who passed this in the first place. ****_Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks._ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125347819/601492326/-1518243115?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjI5NGIzMC0zMjA5LWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDIyNDgyYTk3MzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cbisk2qV_2XWXz4uyMeImI0JyXJEOZhg7WUSUFFb9UI=&emci=e400d1d1-2f09-f111-832e-0022482a9733&emdi=1f294b30-3209-f111-832e-0022482a9733&ceid=4925535) Hoosiers energy bills rose by an average of almost 20% in 2025, one of the highest rates in the country. These rate increases were approved by Mike Braun’s IURC despite widespread opposition from the public. The Republican supermajority has built a system where rates increase automatically, and Hoosiers have no voice in the process. State Rep. Mike Andrade (D-Munster) hosted a town hall last weekend on this issue, and was joined by State Rep. Matt Pierce (D-Bloomington). Democrats proposed over a dozen amendments during this legislative session to freeze sales tax on electricity and cap rate increases. All were rejected by the Braun Republican supermajority. clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important facts - a kernel of truth - from the week. = ** Democrats Running In Every State Senate District For First Time Since 1974 Hoosier Democrats are entering this election cycle with all the momentum. For the first time since the aftermath of the Watergate scandal in 1974, we have Democratic candidates running for every Indiana State Senate seat up for election this November. We also have State House candidates running in 91 of 100 districts, the most since Indiana instituted single-member districts in 1992. Hoosiers are fed up with 21+ years of unchecked Republican rule and ready to elect Democrats all across the state. = Harmful Language Allowing Large Projects Without Public Input Removed From Bill After Public Backlash The Braun Republican supermajority in the Indiana State House last week passed HB 1333, which would have stripped oversight authority on large commercial developments away from local government, making it easier for major projects like industrial facilities and data centers to move forward without input from the community. Farm families, local leaders, and Hoosiers across the political spectrum stood up and made their voices heard, and this language was removed from the bill. When Hoosiers stand together, we can accomplish anything. Now it’s time to replace the Republicans who passed this in the first place. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. Hoosiers energy bills rose by an average of almost 20% in 2025, one of the highest rates in the country. These rate increases were approved by Mike Braun’s IURC despite widespread opposition from the public. The Republican supermajority has built a system where rates increase automatically, and Hoosiers have no voice in the process. State Rep. Mike Andrade (D-Munster) hosted a town hall last weekend on this issue, and was joined by State Rep. Matt Pierce (D-Bloomington). Democrats proposed over a dozen amendments during this legislative session to freeze sales tax on electricity and cap rate increases. All were rejected by the Braun Republican supermajority. While Republicans hide from Hoosiers on rising utility bills, our legislators will keep showing up to listen to and advocate for working Hoosiers. Information on County Party events, Town Halls, protests, volunteer opportunities, and more can be found on our Upcoming Candidate Trainings Are you a candidate for office in the Central Indiana area? We’d love to have you attend our upcoming Candidate Training with Hamilton County Democrats on February 28! Patriot,

Before Rome fell, its citizens drifted from the virtues that built and sustained the republic.

Decadence replaced discipline.
Hedonism overshadowed hard work.
The pursuit of comfort eclipsed the pursuit of truth.

We’re seeing the same issues today.

**The pillars of Western civilization — family, faith, and freedom — are crumbling under the weight of mistrust.**

Hypocrisy and mismanagement have eroded confidence in our government, our media, academia, and beyond. People no longer believe what they see or hear, especially in a world of deepfakes and “artificial everything.”

Civilization cannot thrive without trust. If trust is broken, truth cannot be heard.

Emergent Order Foundation exists to restore both through honesty and integrity. **We are building a new kind of PBS — one rooted in virtue, freedom, and human respect.**

We believe powerful, heroic stories can help advance Western Civilization and unlock the potential in each of us.

[My goal is to bring on 100 new donors this month to create the pro-America PBS. Please click here to support this vision. >>>](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.-yyw/sep5664fd9a)
[**Donate**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.-yyw/s5h7a510016)
Over the past decade, our team at Emergent Order Foundation has produced dozens of films and series, garnering critical acclaim and distribution across major platforms.

Our channels showcase trusted voices with the purpose of entertaining, educating, and inspiring people to rediscover the classical virtues that underpin American freedom.

**Dad Saves America**

Dad Saves America arms the next generation of fathers with a better understanding of our world and how to raise the next generation to thrive in a free society and want to keep it.

We launched Dad Saves America in February 2022. Since then, it’s exploded in popularity!
* +1,000 videos published
* +500,000 cross-platform subscribers
* +6 million hours watched
* +50 million total views

Through this channel, we’re creating a movement of dads and could-be dads who embrace our heroic calling to raise a new generation ready to be champions of Western Civilization.
[**Donate**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.-yyw/s5of2506af7)
**The Censorship Files**

In January, our interview with Michael Shellenberger on the true causes of California’s wildfires reached over 1.6 million viewers — surpassing his Joe Rogan and Tucker Carlson appearances.

That viral success sparked a major new partnership: the production of a feature-length documentary on the global censorship industrial complex. The film will expose how a hidden system of government and corporate censorship is reshaping American democracy.
[**Donate**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.-yyw/s4qcc4b1a4f)
Emergent Order Foundation is creating a new media ecosystem focused on aspirational, virtue-driven stories to inspire all of us to embrace our full potential.

As a non-profit organization, we are only concerned with serving our mission: to be a clear, strong, trusted voice speaking out to save America and the West.

_The last thing our country needs is another woke media company like PBS, NPR, or Disney._

Our powerful, principled storytelling has touched hearts, changed minds, and transformed classrooms.

[Please donate today and help us rebuild trust, restore civilization, and unleash the freedom mindset.](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.-yyw/s0vfe892fbd)

name: Heather G.
subject: Republicans are coming after families like mine
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/103117?t=6&akid=23030%2E878179%2EDkHZhg) Friend, I’m the Executive Director of the Voter Protection Project and I’m fuming with rage.

**House Republicans just passed The Save America Act—a voter suppression bill that directly attacks families like mine.**

My wife and I met in 2016 working at a Democratic polling firm. We knocked doors together. We worked midterms together. We postponed our wedding when COVID shut the world down.

When we finally got married in 2022, we combined our last names — something our friends had joked about for years. It felt joyful. It felt like building a life together.

Like millions of married women in this country, that means our birth certificates no longer match our legal names.

We’re lucky. We both have updated passports with our new last name.

**But unfortunately, a lot of Americans don’t.**

The SAVE Act would create new documentation requirements that could turn something as common as a name change into a barrier to registering and voting.

Noncitizen voting is already illegal and exceedingly rare.

This bill doesn’t solve a real problem. It tells us exactly who Republicans don’t want at the ballot box. And that’s why we’re fighting back.

[The Voter Protection Project works every day to protect voters and elect Democrats who will defend the freedom to vote — not restrict it. If you believe the right to vote should never depend on whether your paperwork is perfectly aligned, will you chip in today? »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/103117?t=7&akid=23030%2E878179%2EDkHZhg) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/103118?t=8&akid=23030%2E878179%2EDkHZhg)

Every dollar you give helps us flip the House and Senate by electing voting rights champions who will fight back against Republican voter suppression.

This fight isn’t theoretical.

**It’s about ensuring families like mine — and families like yours — can participate in our democracy without jumping through unnecessary hoops.**

We’re not backing down.

In solidarity,

Heather G.
Executive Director
The Voter Protection Project

**P.S. The SAVE Act is a warning shot. Republicans are telling us exactly who they don’t want at the ballot box.[Let’s answer by electing Democrats who will defend every eligible American’s freedom to vote. Chip in now »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/103117?t=13&akid=23030%2E878179%2EDkHZhg)**
